lines.japanese:
目が覚めない。
　暗い夢に沈んだまま、目を覚ます気配がない。
―――ゾッとした。
　何の理由もなく、さしたる確証もなく。
　俺はこのままずっと、夢から覚めないのだと、わかってしまった。
lines.label: s399
lines.maoEnglish:
I cannot wake. I remain submerged in a dark dream, with no sign that waking will ever come.
—A chill went through me. For no reason, with no evidence at all, I suddenly knew that I would remain in this dream forever.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
I cannot wake up.
Immersed in a dark dream, I can't wake up.
---I feel a chill go down my spine.
Without reason, without purpose.
I realize I will never be able to wake from this dream.

lines.japanese:
「志貴さま、お時間ですよ。
起きてくださらないと学校に遅れてしまいます」
「―――――――――え？」
　目の前に翡翠の姿がある。
　ここは自分の部屋で、外は呆れかえるぐらいのいい天気だった。
「ひ……すい？」
「おはようございます志貴さま。
今朝はいつもよりお時間がおしておりますので、お早く居間においでください」
　翡翠はいつも通り、淡々と声をあげる。
lines.label: s399
lines.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, it is time to wake. If you do not get up, you will be late for school.”
“—What?” Hisui stood before me. I was in my own room, and the weather outside was almost absurdly beautiful. “Hi…sui?”
“Good morning, Master Shiki. We are running later than usual today, so please come to the sitting room at once.” Hisui spoke in the same calm, even voice as always.
lines.mao_english:
“Master Shiki, it is time to wake. If you do not get up, you will be late for school.”
“—What?” Hisui stood before me. I was in my own room, and the weather outside was almost absurdly beautiful. “Hi…sui?”
“Good morning, Master Shiki. We are running later than usual today, so please come to the sitting room at once.” Hisui spoke in the same calm, even voice as always.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama, please wake up.
You will be late for school."
"---------Eh?"
Hisui is in front of me.
This is my room, and there is surprisingly great weather outside.
"Hi…… sui?"
"Good morning, Shiki-sama.
You do not have as much time today, so please hurry to the sitting room."
As usual, Hisui speaks in her detached tone.

lines.japanese:
「は―――――――ぁ」
　それで、何もかも消え去ってくれた。
　目が覚めている自分と、確かに鼓動している自分の体を抱きしめる。
　……ホッとする。
　さっきまでの悪夢が、本当になんていう事はない、ただの悪夢に変わってくれた。
「……よかった。
翡翠が起こしてくれなかったら、あのまま、目覚めなかったかもしれない」
lines.label: s399
lines.maoEnglish: “Hah—” And with that, everything vanished. I wrapped my arms around myself—my waking self, my body with its heart beating unmistakably inside it. …Relief flooded me. The nightmare that had held me moments ago had become exactly that: an ordinary nightmare, nothing more. “…What a relief. If you hadn’t woken me, Hisui, I might never have come back.”
lines.mao_english: “Hah—” And with that, everything vanished. I wrapped my arms around myself—my waking self, my body with its heart beating unmistakably inside it. …Relief flooded me. The nightmare that had held me moments ago had become exactly that: an ordinary nightmare, nothing more. “…What a relief. If you hadn’t woken me, Hisui, I might never have come back.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Oh------h."
With that, everything disappeared.
I embrace my recently awakened but still throbbing body.
…… I feel relieved.
The awful world I was in until just now has just turned into a dream.
"…… Thanks.
If you hadn't woken me up, I might have never woken up."

lines.japanese:
「志貴さま……？
　体調が優れないのでしたら、どうぞそうおっしゃってください」
「いや、そうじゃないんだ。
―――おはよう翡翠。
きみがいてくれて、よかった」
「え――――あ、はい。
ありがとうございます、志貴さま」
　微かに頬を染めて、翡翠は頭をさげてくる。
「いや、そうじゃないんだ。
本当にお礼がいいたいのは俺のほう―――――って、もう七時半じゃないか！
　ごめん、すぐ起きるから先に居間に行っててくれ！」
「はい、それではお待ちしております」
　翡翠が退室していくのと同時に、寝巻から学生服に着替える。
lines.label: s399
lines.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki…? If you are unwell, please tell me.” “No, that isn’t it. Good morning, Hisui. I’m so glad you’re here.”
“Oh—yes. Thank you, Master Shiki.” A faint blush touched Hisui’s cheeks as she bowed. “No, I’m the one who should be thanking—wait, it’s already seven thirty! Sorry, I’ll get up now, so go ahead to the sitting room!” “Very well. I shall wait for you there.”
As Hisui left, I changed out of my pajamas and into my school uniform.
lines.mao_english:

As Hisui left, I changed out of my pajamas and into my school uniform.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama……?
If you are not feeling well, please tell me so."

Sorry, I'll get up, so please go wait in the sitting room!"
"Yes, I will be waiting."
Right as Hisui leaves the room, I change into my school uniform.

lines.japanese:
ベッドから跳ね起きて、琥珀さんの作ってくれた朝食を少しだけ食べて玄関に出る。
　所要時間は実に十分とかかっていない。
「それじゃ行ってくる。
またな、翡翠！」
「はい。
お帰りをお待ちしております」
lines.label: s399
lines.maoEnglish:
I sprang out of bed, ate a little of the breakfast Kohaku had made, and reached the front door. The entire operation took less than ten minutes.
“I’m off. See you later, Hisui!”
“Yes. I shall await your return.”

lines.japanese:
「……間に合ったぁ……」
　はあ、と息をついて体を休める。
　間に合った、といっても校門が閉められる時間に間に合っただけで、ここからさらに教室までスパートをかけないといけない。
lines.label: s399
lines.maoEnglish: “…Made it…” I paused to catch my breath. By “made it,” I meant only that I had beaten the closing of the school gates. I still had to sprint all the way to my classroom.
lines.mao_english: “…Made it…” I paused to catch my breath. By “made it,” I meant only that I had beaten the closing of the school gates. I still had to sprint all the way to my classroom.

"…… I made it……"

I made it just in time before they closed the gate, but I still have to make it to class.

lines.japanese:
「………はぁ」
　まだ担任は教室に到着していなかった。
　走り通しで荒くなった呼吸を整えながら自分の席に座る。
　……教室の様子は、いつもより賑やかだ。
　明日が創立記念日で休校なものだから、みんな気分が土曜日になっているのかもしれない。
lines.label: s399
lines.maoEnglish: “…Hah.” Our homeroom teacher had not arrived yet. I dropped into my seat and tried to bring my ragged breathing under control. …The classroom was livelier than usual. Tomorrow was the school’s anniversary and therefore a holiday; perhaps everyone had already slipped into a Saturday mood.

lines.japanese:
「……昨日の夢」
　たしかに昨日、ここで人を殺す夢を見た。
　自分なりに夢を見ないようにと努力はしたけど、自分自身からは逃げられないという事なのか。
「―――――く」
　ぎり、と歯をかみ締める。
　弱気になっている自分が情けない。
　あれは所詮、夢にすぎないことだ。
　たしかにあんな夢を見るのはどうかしてるけど、今はまだ自分は正気のままだと思う。
lines.label: s399
lines.maoEnglish: “…Last night’s dream.” I had dreamed of killing someone here. I had done what I could to keep myself from dreaming again, but perhaps there was no escaping myself. “—Damn.” I clenched my teeth. I hated how frightened I had become. It was only a dream. Dreaming anything so grotesque was certainly abnormal, but for now, at least, I still believed myself sane.

Dreaming anything so grotesque was certainly abnormal, but for now, at least, I still believed myself sane.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yesterday's dream."
This is definitely the place where I saw someone get killed in my dream.
Even though I tried as hard as I could not to dream, I guess you can't run away from yourself.
"-----Kk."
I grind my teeth.
I feel pitiful about my weakness.
After all, it's all a dream.
Certainly there is something wrong with me seeing those dreams, but I think I'm still sane.

「お帰りなさいませ、志貴さま」

「ただいま。
すぐ部屋に戻るから、翡翠は自分の仕事に戻っていいよ」
「はい。
では居間の掃除に戻りますので、何かご用がおありでしたらお声をかけてください」
「……翡翠は居間の掃除、か……」

lines.maoEnglish:
“Welcome home, Master Shiki.” The moment I opened the front door, Hisui greeted me with a formal bow. “I’m back. I’m going straight to my room, so you can return to your work.” “Very well. I shall resume cleaning the sitting room. Please call for me if you require anything.”
“…Hisui’s cleaning the sitting room…” Kohaku was nowhere in sight, but she was probably cleaning the back garden or out shopping. Akiha did not seem to be home yet either, so I decided to return to my room.

I meant to eat lunch at school, but the memory of yesterday’s incident in the cafeteria killed my appetite, and in the end I ate nothing.

lines.maoEnglish: …I would impose on Kohaku and ask her to make me a light snack.
lines.mao_english: …I would impose on Kohaku and ask her to make me a light snack.
lines.mirrorMoon: …… It is a little selfish, but I'd better ask Kohaku-san to make me something to eat.

lines.japanese:
「あ、志貴さん。
帰ってきていたんですね」
　ホウキを掃く手を止めて、琥珀さんはペコリとおじぎをしてくる。
「ああ、ただいま。
それで琥珀さん、帰ってきてそうそう悪いんだけど、その」
「はい？
　何か特別なご用があるんですか？」
「えっと、実は恥ずかしながらですね」
　おなかがすいているので何か作ってください、と言う前に。
　ぐるううう、とおなかの音が中庭に鳴り響いた。
lines.label: s400
lines.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Shiki. I didn’t realize you were home.” Kohaku stopped sweeping and gave me a small bow. “I’m back. Sorry to bother you the moment I get home, Kohaku, but…”
“Yes? Is there something special you need?” “Well, embarrassing as this is…” Before I could ask her to make something because I was hungry—
My stomach unleashed a long growl that echoed across the courtyard.
lines.mao_english:
“Oh, Shiki. I didn’t realize you were home.” Kohaku stopped sweeping and gave me a small bow. “I’m back. Sorry to bother you the moment I get home, Kohaku, but…”
“Yes? Is there something special you need?” “Well, embarrassing as this is…” Before I could ask her to make something because I was hungry—
My stomach unleashed a long growl that echoed across the courtyard.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Ah, Shiki-san.
You're back."
Moving the broom off to one side, Kohaku-san bows.
"Yeah, I'm back.
I do have a little favor to ask, though."
"Yes?
Is there something special you need?"
"Um, I'm a little embarrassed, but…"
Before I could even ask her nicely to make me something to eat,
the growling of my stomach rumbles through the courtyard.

lines.japanese:
「――――――」
　呆気にとられたのか、琥珀さんはまじまじとこっちの顔を見つめてくる。
「―――――う」
　なにか、自分がこの上なく節操のない人間のように思えて赤面してしまう。
「……えー、まあこういうワケなんです。
朝からごはんを食べていないもんだから、夕食まで我慢できそうにないな、と」
「――――――」
　琥珀さんは無言で俺を眺めて、くすっ、と思い出したように笑いだした。
lines.label: s400
lines.maoEnglish: “…” Apparently dumbfounded, Kohaku stared openly at my face. “Urk—” I blushed, feeling like some creature utterly devoid of self-control. “…Well, that explains it. I haven’t eaten since morning, and I don’t think I can last until dinner.” “…” Kohaku regarded me in silence, then, as though something had just come back to her, gave a quiet laugh.
lines.mao_english: “…” Apparently dumbfounded, Kohaku stared openly at my face. “Urk—” I blushed, feeling like some creature utterly devoid of self-control. “…Well, that explains it. I haven’t eaten since morning, and I don’t think I can last until dinner.” “…” Kohaku regarded me in silence, then, as though something had just come back to her, gave a quiet laugh.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"------"
Surprised, Kohaku-san just gapes.
"-----Uh."
My face turns red… I didn't realize my body was that crass…
"…… Um, so that's it.
I didn't have much to eat since morning, so I can't wait until dinner…"
"------"
Kohaku-san stares at me wordlessly and then, as if remembering, lets out a little laugh.

「はい、それでしたら何か軽いものをお作りいたしますね。
志貴さん、何かお食べになりたいものはありますか？」
「食べたいもの、ですか？」

lines.label: s400
lines.maoEnglish: “In that case, I’ll make something light. Shiki, is there anything in particular you would like?” “Anything in particular?” …Now that she asked, I realized I had only a vague sense of hunger, with no clear image of what I wanted to eat.

lines.japanese:
「うーん……それじゃホットケーキかなんか作ってもらえたらいいかな、とか」
　どうしてか、ワケもなく蜂蜜のかけられた黄色いパンケーキが頭に浮かんだ。
「ホットケーキ、ですか……？
　志貴さん、甘いものはお嫌いだって聞いていますけど」
　と、意外そうに首をかしげる琥珀さん。
「あ―――いや、過剰な糖分は摂らないようにしてるけど、嫌いってわけじゃないよ。
有間の家にいた頃も、和菓子はよく食べてたし」
lines.label: s400
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hmm… Maybe you could make pancakes or something?” For no reason I could name, a stack of golden pancakes drizzled with honey appeared in my mind.
“Pancakes…? Shiki, I had heard that you disliked sweets.” Kohaku tilted her head in surprise. “Ah—no, I avoid too much sugar, but I don’t dislike it. I ate Japanese sweets fairly often when I lived with the Arimas.”

「まあ、そうだったんですか！
　なんだ、そういう事でしたらもっと早く言ってくださいな。
　わたし、お茶会の時に志貴さんには何をご用意しようかってずっと悩んでたんですけど、これからは秋葉さまと同じものをお作りできますね」
　嬉しそうに琥珀さんは声を弾ませる。
　……けど秋葉と一緒ってことは、あの食べるのが勿体ないぐらいキレイなショートケーキを出されるってコトなんだろうか。
lines.label: s400
lines.maoEnglish: “Oh, did you? You should have told me sooner! I’ve always wondered what to prepare for you at teatime, Shiki, but now I can make the same things for you and Miss Akiha.” Kohaku’s voice danced with delight. …But if I received the same thing as Akiha, did that mean those exquisite little strawberry cakes that looked far too beautiful to eat?

「でしょう？
　わたしも不思議に思って訊いてみたらですね、“これが一番簡単だ”ってわたしが言ったからだそうなんです。
　でも翡翠ちゃん、まだ自分で納得のいく味付けはできないとかなんとか」

lines.label: s400
lines.maoEnglish: “Really…? That’s unexpected. I always imagined Hisui preferring something more complicated.” Something so delicate you could not tell where to put the knife. “I thought so too. When I asked, she said it was because I had told her pancakes were the easiest thing to make. But apparently she still hasn’t managed a flavor she considers satisfactory.” “…?” …Wasn’t that less a love of pancakes than a determined campaign to master them?

Her earlier refusal had been a brutal blow, but compared with this Hisui, it was only a light jab.

lines.maoEnglish:
Kohaku cooked for me every day, of course, but she was so brisk and professional that the cook named “Kohaku” seemed almost like a different person, and I could never entirely relax.
Hisui, on the other hand, had never made anything resembling a meal for me. That made the wait strangely thrilling.

Hisui stood without moving, her head still bowed. “…Ah.” I had licked the fingers of a girl who hated being touched by men. Worse—I had sucked her blood for all that time.

lines.maoEnglish:
“…Master Shiki, you were only concerned about my injury. You have nothing to apologize for.” “No, that isn’t what I—”
—I couldn’t look at Hisui. The taste of her blood still lingered. I could not forget the feel of her finger against my tongue.
“—I’m sorry. I know I asked, but forget the food. I’m going back to my room—please leave me alone for a while.”
Hisui said nothing. Fleeing the pressure of her silence, I ran for my room.

“No, I apologize for not being at your side when you woke.” Hisui bows without a sound. …Her face is blank. The memory of last night’s dream stirs, and guilt knots inside me.

廊下は長く延びている。
　子供のころは、この廊下がどこまでも続いているんだって信じて疑わなかった。
　屋敷は城のように広くて、毎日少しずつ歩き回っては壁や柱、床に自分の名前を刻み付けた。
　当時、秋葉との遊びで陣地取りみたいなゲームが流行ったせいだ。
　名前を刻んだところが自分の領地だ、なんていって二人で屋敷じゅう歩き回っては、自分の名前を刻んでいったんだっけ。

lines.maoEnglish:
The corridor runs on and on. As a child, I never doubted it continued forever. The mansion seemed as vast as a castle, and every day I explored a little more of it, carving my name into walls, pillars, and floors. Akiha and I had become obsessed with a game of claiming territory.
Wherever we carved our names became our territory. We roamed the entire mansion together, leaving our names behind.

lines.japanese:
――――白く溶けてしまいそうな夏の陽射し。
　遠くのそらには入道雲。
　見えるのは空蝉のこえ。
　足元には蝉のぬけがら。
　ぬけがら。
誰かの、ぬけがら。
「―――――――――…………………………」
　傷が開く。
　胸が真っ赤に染まって、この両手まで赤黒く赫灼と―――――
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
Summer sunlight, bleached white enough to dissolve the world.
Far away, thunderheads climb the sky. I can see the voice of an empty cicada shell. At my feet lies a cast-off husk. A husk. What someone left behind.
“……………………”
The wound tears open. My chest floods scarlet, and even my hands blaze dark with blood—

lines.japanese:
「一体どういうつもりなの翡翠。
志貴をあそこに近づけてはいけないって、あなたも知っているでしょうに……！」
「もうしわけ…………ありません」
「謝って済む問題じゃないわ。
あなたを兄さん付きの使用人にしたのは、こういう事態を避けるためでしょう？
　それを忘れて、あなたは何をやっていたっていうのよ……！」
　秋葉は普段からでは考えられないぐらい、感情を剥き出しにして怒っている。
　対して、叱られている翡翠はうつむいたままずっと黙っていた。

lines.maoEnglish:
“What were you thinking, Hisui? You knew Shiki must never be allowed near that place…!”
“I am… terribly sorry.” “Sorry does not begin to answer for this. You were assigned to Brother precisely to prevent something like this. Did you forget? What in heaven’s name were you doing…!” Akiha’s fury is naked in a way I have never seen before. Hisui keeps her head bowed and suffers the rebuke in silence.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Just what in the world were you trying to do, Hisui?
You know not to let Shiki go near that place……!"
"Please…… forgive me."
"This can't be solved by apologizing.

So what were you doing……!?"

In comparison, Hisui is accepting the scolding, looking down silently.

lines.japanese:

　頬にふれて、自分が泣いている事に気がついた。
　なにが悲しかったのか、なにが痛かったのか、よく解らない。
　ただ、ひどく大切なものから離されたという感覚だけ、胸に残っている。
「悪い夢じゃなかった、のかな」
　今まで見ていた殺人の夢とは違っていたと思う。
　昨夜は何日かぶりに、よく眠れた夜だった。

lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“What… why?” Touching my cheek, I realize I am crying. I don’t know what made me sad, or what caused me pain. Only the feeling of having been torn from something terribly precious remains inside my chest.
“Maybe… it wasn’t a bad dream.”
It felt different from the dreams of murder I have been having. For the first time in days, I slept well last night. Surely that was because Hisui stayed nearby and watched over me.

I think this is different than those dreams where I killed people.
But it was the first time that I slept so well in many days.
Maybe it was because Hisui was watching me the whole time.

I'm able to be calm right now because of you being here.
…… It's more than you looking after me; if you weren't here, I don't know what I would do."
"……?
Because of me?"
"Of course.
Ever since I came here, I've been uneasy, and always had these nightmares.
But when you say good morning to me every day, I'm able to be at peace.
---Therefore, you have helped me so many times.
Like today, when you came, it made me happy."

だから、翡翠はすごく俺を助けてくれてるんだって」
「あの……ほんとうに、そうでしょうか」
「本当もほんとう。
その証拠にね、今朝はまだ朝を迎えたような気になれないんだ。

「―――――――」

lines.maoEnglish:

“…” Hisui lifts her eyes to me hesitantly, then seems to draw one small, deep breath.

精密検査といっても、どうせ血圧とかを測る程度だと楽観していたのが甘かった。

　本格的に体中の検査をされて、お医者さんが屋敷を後にしたのが正午すぎ。

lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
I had optimistically assumed that a thorough examination meant no more than taking my blood pressure. That was naive. Whether because the Tohnos are rich or simply divorced from common sense, the doctor arrives with a heap of elaborate equipment and turns the adjoining room into a temporary clinic.
After subjecting every part of me to a proper examination, the doctor finally leaves shortly after noon. Only then does Kohaku help me back to my room. Altogether, they kept me captive for nearly four hours.

lines.mirrorMoon:

Leaning on Kohaku's shoulder, I stumble back to my room.
All in all, everything took about four hours.

lines.japanese:
「…………はあ」
　ベッドに横になって、軽くため息をつく。
　あれだけ検査をしても異状は見当たらないという事だった。
　……まあ、そもそも八年前の事故で命をとりとめた時点で奇跡的だったんだから、お医者さまも原因不明の病状、というものをあっさり受け入れてくれた。
　とりあえずの方針として、こうしてベッドで休んでいる事が最適らしい。
　点滴をされるのかとも思ったが、異状のない体に薬を投与するのはそれこそ危険なんだそうだ。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish: “…Haa.” Lying in bed, I let out a small sigh. Despite all those tests, they found nothing wrong. …Then again, my survival after the accident eight years ago was itself a miracle, so the doctor readily accepts another unexplained condition. For now, apparently, the best treatment is simply to rest in bed. I thought they might put me on an IV, but administering medicine to a body with no detectable abnormality would be dangerous in its own right.

Well, the best policy is just to sleep here in bed.
I thought maybe I should get an IV or something, but if there's nothing wrong with my body, he said it's better if I don't take any medicine.

「え――――？」

lines.japanese:
「翡翠……いつのまに部屋に入ってきたんだ？」
「いつのまに……とおっしゃられても。
わたしは五分ほど前に、志貴さまのシーツをお取り替えし終わったところです」
「そうなんだ。
悪い、さっきまで眠ってたみたいで、翡翠が入ってきた事に気付いてなかった」
「……志貴さま、悪ふざけはおやめください。
入室を許されたのも志貴さまですし、シーツを取り替えるように指示をくださったのも志貴さまです」
「な―――――――」
　なんだそれ。
　俺はさっきまで眠っていて、またイヤな夢を見て、翡翠の声で目が覚めたのに……？
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hisui… when did you come in?”
“When…? I finished changing your sheets about five minutes ago, Master Shiki.”
“Oh. Sorry—I must have been asleep until just now. I didn’t notice you come in.”
“…Master Shiki, please don’t tease me. You were the one who allowed me in, and you were also the one who instructed me to change the sheets.”
“What—?”
What was she talking about? I’d been asleep until a moment ago, trapped in another horrible dream, and Hisui’s voice had woken me… hadn’t it?

lines.japanese:
「……翡翠。
俺、起きてるように見えたのか？」
「……はい。
シーツを取り替えたあと、志貴さまが目を閉じられたのでこれからお眠りになるのか尋ねていたところですが」
「―――いや。
当分、眠らない」
　なんとかそう返答して、自分の手を見た。
　……手を持ち上げる事が、今は難しい。
　体調は朝から一向に回復しない。
　重い体。
　今まで自分の――――遠野志貴の体と思っていたこの体が、見知らぬ他人のモノのような違和感がする。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Hisui. Did I look awake to you?”
“…Yes. After I changed the sheets, you closed your eyes, so I was asking whether you meant to sleep now.”
“No. I won’t be sleeping again for a while.”
I managed to answer, then looked down at my hand. Even lifting it was difficult now. I hadn’t improved at all since morning. My body was leaden. This body I had always believed was mine—Shiki Tohno’s—now felt like the flesh of some stranger I had never met.

I managed to answer, then looked down at my hand. Even lifting it was difficult now. I hadn’t improved at all since morning. My body was leaden. This body I had always believed was mine—Shiki Tohno’s—now felt like the flesh of some stranger I had never met.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Hisui.
Did I look like I was awake?"
"…… Yes.
After I changed the sheets, you closed your eyes, which is why I inquired if you were sleeping."
"---No, I won't sleep anymore right now."
Somehow responding, I look at my hand.
…… Lifting my hand is still difficult.
I haven't gotten even the slightest bit better.
My heavy body.
My body----the body of Tohno Shiki, feels like it belongs to some other person.

“No, you don’t have to stand on ceremony the whole time. Bring in a chair, read a book—do whatever you’d normally do. I’ll just be passing the time myself.”

「律儀だな、翡翠は」
　呟いて、つい笑いがこぼれた。
　この屋敷で翡翠と再会した時、無表情で冷たい女の子だと思ったのが懐かしい。
　あの時はそうとしか思えなかったけど、今は―――翡翠がどんな子なのか、少しずつ分かってきた。
「―――早く来ないかな、翡翠」
　ベッドに体を預けて、本心からそう思った。
　彼女が傍にいてくれるのなら、こうして病人でいるのも、そう悪いことじゃないだろう。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“She really does take everything seriously.”
A smile escaped me as I said it. It seemed almost funny now that, when I first met Hisui again in this house, I had taken her for a cold, expressionless girl. I hadn’t been able to see her any other way then, but now—little by little—I was beginning to understand what she was really like.
“I wish she’d hurry back.”
I let myself sink into the bed, meaning it with all my heart. If having her beside me was the reward, perhaps being ill wasn’t entirely terrible.

I let myself sink into the bed, meaning it with all my heart. If having her beside me was the reward, perhaps being ill wasn’t entirely terrible.
lines.mirrorMoon:

"---C'mon, Hisui, hurry back."

If she's going to be around, being sick like I am right now doesn't sound bad at all.

lines.japanese:
翡翠の看病は、それこそただ一緒にいるだけのものだった。
　異性の体に触れられない、という翡翠はこっちの容体を看ることができない。
　熱を測ったり汗を拭いたりしてくれるのは琥珀さんの役目で、翡翠は傍にいてこっちの『喉が渇いた』といった要望を聞いてくれるだけだ。
　けど、それが不満というわけでもない。
　一日中部屋にいてくれる、というわけではなかったけど、それでも極力部屋にいてくれたおかげで、あれ以降おかしな夢は見なかった。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
Hisui’s nursing amounted, quite literally, to keeping me company. Since she could not bring herself to touch a man, she couldn’t examine me. Taking my temperature and wiping away my sweat were Kohaku’s duties; Hisui merely stayed nearby and saw to requests such as “I’m thirsty.”
Not that I minded. She couldn’t remain in the room all day, but she stayed as much as she could—and thanks to that, I had no more strange dreams.

Hisui nursing me turns out to be her just being with me.

But that doesn't mean that I'm dissatisfied.
It's not that she was always there, but she was there most of the time.
Thanks to that, I didn't see any terrible dreams.

Akiha let out a long breath, the tension leaving her chest.

lines.maoEnglish:
“Good night, Brother. And please don’t overexert yourself just because you feel better. If you injure yourself now, we’ll be right back where we started.”

With a soft “Good night” and a faint smile, Akiha left.

lines.japanese:
「―――――」
　就寝時間になった。
　どのみち体が動かないんじゃ動き回ることはできない。
　きちんと眠って、明日には体を回復させないといけない。
　今夜は何も考えず、ただ眠ることにした。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“….”
It was time for bed. My body wouldn’t let me go anywhere regardless. I needed a full night’s sleep if I meant to recover by morning. So tonight, I decided to think of nothing at all and simply sleep.
lines.mao_english:
“….”
It was time for bed. My body wouldn’t let me go anywhere regardless. I needed a full night’s sleep if I meant to recover by morning. So tonight, I decided to think of nothing at all and simply sleep.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
It is time for bed.
If I can't move, I can't go out anywhere.
I have to get enough sleep and make sure that I'll be better tomorrow.
Not thinking of anything, I decide to sleep for tonight.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
窓から差しこんでくる朝日で目が覚めた。
「―――見なかったな、夢」
　いい夢もわるい夢もなかった、真っ白い眠りだった。
　おかげで気分はそう悪いものじゃない。
　今日は土曜日だし、学校が終わったら翡翠や琥珀さんに看病してくれたお礼をしなくては、なんて考えがうかぶ。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
Morning sunlight through the window woke me.
“No dreams.”
Neither good nor bad—only a pure blank of sleep. I felt fairly well for it. It was Saturday; once school was over, I ought to find some way to thank Hisui and Kohaku for looking after me. The thought came easily.
lines.mao_english:
Morning sunlight through the window woke me.
“No dreams.”
Neither good nor bad—only a pure blank of sleep. I felt fairly well for it. It was Saturday; once school was over, I ought to find some way to thank Hisui and Kohaku for looking after me. The thought came easily.
lines.mirrorMoon:
The light from the window wakes me up.
"---I didn't have any dreams."
It really was just a sleep without dreams, good or bad.
Thanks to that, I don't feel bad at all.
Today's Saturday, so I should probably thank Hisui and Kohaku-san for taking care of me.

lines.japanese:
時刻は朝の六時を過ぎたばかり。
　一日中横になっていたから眠気なんて微塵もない。
「―――よし、起きるか」
　ベッドから体を起こす。
「―――――え」
　体が動かない。
　……容体は、まったく治っていない。
　それどころか悪化している。
昨日は自分の腕ぐらいは動かすことができたのに、今はそんな単純なことが辛い。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
It was only just past six. After lying down all day yesterday, I wasn’t the least bit sleepy.
“All right. Time to get up.”
I tried to rise from the bed.
“What…?”
My body wouldn’t move. I hadn’t recovered at all. If anything, I was worse. Yesterday I could at least move my arms; now even that simple act was an ordeal.

lines.mirrorMoon:

"---Time to get up!"
I get up from bed.
"-----Eh?"
My body doesn't move at all.
…… I haven't healed at all.
If anything, it's worse.
Yesterday, I could move my arms, but today I can't even do that.

lines.japanese:
「――――っ、く――――」
　片腕を垂直に上げてみる。
　……。
　…………。
　………………。
「――――はっ……あ」
　ようやく上がった。
　たったそれだけの事をするのに、体中の力をつかって、一分近くかかってしまっている。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ngh… come on….”
I tried raising one arm straight into the air.
…
……
………
“Hah… ah….”
At last, it rose. That tiny motion had taken every ounce of strength in my body and nearly a full minute.

"----Ha…… ah."

lines.japanese:
「……どうなってるんだ、これ」
　これじゃ死体だ。
　それとも動力のきれたロボットか。
　ともかく体が動かない。
　けど、そのわりには意識ははっきりしているし、痛みはまったく感じない。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“…What the hell is happening to me?”
I might as well have been a corpse. Or a robot with its power cut. Whatever the comparison, my body refused to move. Yet my mind was perfectly clear, and I felt no pain at all.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's going on?"
It's like my body is dead.

lines.japanese:
「翡翠―――琥珀さん、ちょっと―――」
　来てくれ、と言おうとして止まった。
　声は出せるけど、大声をあげようとすると眩暈がする。
　……大声をあげるにも筋力を使うから、その負荷で脳に血がたまっていくような感覚。
「はっ―――――」
　軽く息を吐く。
　こうなったら翡翠が起こしに来てくれるまで、こうして待っているしかないだろう。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hisui—Kohaku, could one of you—”
I stopped before I could call for them to come. I could speak, but trying to raise my voice made the room spin. Shouting took muscle too, and the strain made it feel as though blood were pooling inside my skull.
“Hah….”
I let out a shallow breath. There was nothing to do but wait like this until Hisui came to wake me.
lines.mao_english:

“Hah….”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Hey, Hisui---Kohaku-san---"
I was going to tell them to come here, but I stop.
I can speak, but using a loud voice makes me extremely dizzy.
…… It almost feels like a loud voice uses too much muscle, placing too much strain on the blood flow to the brain.
"Ha-----"
I breathe out.
I guess all I can do is just wait for Hisui to come wake me up.

lines.japanese:
―――その後は、まるっきり昨日の朝の焼きなおしだった。
　初めからこっちがベッドで倒れていた分、話は少しだけ早かったが大筋は変わらない。
　俺を起こしに来た翡翠は顔を蒼白にして琥珀さんを呼びにいって、琥珀さんは俺の体を看てくれた。
　話を聞きつけた秋葉がまた駆けつけてきて、昨日と同じように医者を呼んで検査をしてもらって、こうしてベッドに体を休めている。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
What followed was a perfect reenactment of the previous morning.
Things went a little faster because I was already lying helpless in bed, but otherwise nothing changed. Hisui came to wake me, went white, and ran for Kohaku, who examined me. Akiha heard the news and rushed in; a doctor was summoned, just as before, and after another examination I was left here to rest.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
---After that, it's pretty much like yesterday morning.
Since I was already in bed, it went by just a bit faster than yesterday.
After coming to wake me up, a pale-faced Hisui called for Kohaku-san, who did a little check up.
Hearing this, Akiha once again ran into my room, called the same doctor as yesterday, who did the same examination, and I end up resting in bed.

「志貴さま、何か言われましたか？」
「ん……？
　いや、ぼんやりとしてただけだよ。
別になにも言ってない」
「―――――――」
「ほら、またそんな顔をする。
別に痛みがあるわけじゃないんだから、翡翠が心配するような事じゃないって言っただろ」
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“Did you say something, Master Shiki?”
“Mm…? No. I was just staring into space. I didn’t say anything.”
“….”
“There, you’re making that face again. I told you, nothing hurts. There’s no reason for you to look so worried.”

「……はい。
もうしわけありません、志貴さま」
「だからいいんだって。
……まったく、翡翠は心配性なんだな。

「え――――姉さんに似ているんですか、わたし」

　……似ているかって、そりゃあ外見はそっくりだ。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Yes. I’m sorry, Master Shiki.”
“I said it’s all right. Honestly, you worry too much. Maybe it runs in the family—you’re just like Kohaku that way.”
“I’m… like my sister?”
Hisui sounded genuinely surprised. As for their looks, of course, the two were almost identical.

lines.japanese:
「ああ、ちょっと昔の話。
子供のころから琥珀さんはお姉さん役だったって知ってるだろ？
　だから俺や秋葉が無茶してケガをすると、琥珀さんがすぐ心配するんだ。
……いや、ケガだけならまだいいんだけど、こっちが少しでも体調を崩していると寝てろ寝てろってやかましかった」
「え……その、やかしまかった、んですか？」
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“I was thinking about when we were children. You know how Kohaku always played the big sister, even then? Whenever Akiha or I did something reckless and got hurt, Kohaku would start fretting immediately. Injuries weren’t even the worst of it. If one of us so much as felt under the weather, she’d nag us endlessly to get into bed.”
“She… nagged you?”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Yeah, it's a pretty old story.

…… No, it's fine if it was only when we were hurt, but even when we were not feeling well, she would be very fussy, telling us to go to sleep, go to sleep."
"Eh…… She was really, that fussy?"

lines.japanese:
「ああ、こっちが照れるぐらいにやかましかった。
　……あれはいつだったかな、確かにちょっと風邪ぎみなのを無視して遊んでたコトがあったんだけどね。
琥珀さん、三人で遊んでいる時に看病してやるからすぐ寝ろいま寝ろって連発してきてさ。
　結局押しに負けて部屋に戻ったんだけど、そのあと楽しそうに濡れたタオルをもってきて人の顔にかけてきたんだ。
窒息死するかと思ったよ、こっちは」
「…………、」
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“Enough to embarrass me. When was it…? Once I ignored the beginnings of a cold and went out to play anyway. The three of us were together, and Kohaku kept insisting she would nurse me, so I had to go to bed right now, this instant.
“In the end she wore me down and marched me back to my room. Then she came in looking delighted, carrying a wet towel, and dropped it over my face. I thought she was going to smother me.”
“….”

"…………,"

“Yes. I’m sure my sister feels the same way.”

lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“Sorry. You must be bored, listening to me talk about things you couldn’t know.”
“Please don’t concern yourself. I’m enjoying it.”
“You are…? Well, if you’re sure….”

“Yes. If you feel well enough, Master Shiki, please continue. The doctor also said you ought to move as much as you can.”

lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:

“….”
I had a very, very bad feeling about this.

I knew it.
“…Ugh.”
The idea was unbearable, but I couldn’t bring myself to refuse outright. If I couldn’t move properly, someone else would have to wash me. I’d been bedridden since yesterday and had sweated through my clothes; to be honest, the sticky feeling was miserable.

lines.maoEnglish:
Ordinarily, even a helpless patient tenses when someone lifts an arm or a leg; the muscles push instinctively against the motion. That resistance is what makes nursing such physical work. I didn’t have even that. I felt like a jellyfish—or some other boneless thing.
“A jellyfish… Maybe that’s closer than I meant it to be.”
It was supposed to be a joke, but I couldn’t laugh. Somehow, I no longer felt alive.

lines.maoEnglish:

“Shiki, please don’t look so frightened. There must be some cause. Once we find it and put it right, I’m sure you’ll recover in no time.”
“…Maybe. But what if there isn’t a cause?”

lines.maoEnglish:
“St… stop—”
Impact. Walls dissolve. Meanings resolve. The self expounds itself. The smoothness of variable translucence. Time in promiscuous congress. Observational life and executive function. A hand without a little finger. An eye without a head. A carpet running away. Single. Double. Triple. Then a leap to seven hundred and seventy-seven cages. A bursting balloon. A promise, from the first, never to fit. A rule, from the first, to spill over. A contract, from the first, to die. Poison and honey. Red and placenta. Mercury lamps and moth lights. Observation of a light source refracted through manifold dimensions; a swimming fish; a screw singing in the sediment of the deep divine. Tools, tools, tools. Raised without end, never reproduced, unto how many stars—without meaning, without will. Easier than coming true. Myself, and no one else. A leaking deep sea. Contradiction born of microscopic bacteria. A quark gazing down from above. Denial of everything. Mother-of-pearl inlay made formless, an embryo developing from a charnel vault—to that impossible law, let the curse itself be a blessing.
#ff0000


Ha. Hahahaha…
“What… is… this—?”
Stasis alone ignored. The earth bleeding. Immortality attained at the price of virulent poison. Roses. Roses. Roses. Roses. Only in splendor does Tai Sui dwell. lines.maoEnglish:
“Damn… it.”
How could this be happening?
“Why… why this…?”
Before, I had thought staying awake would destroy my mind before my body.
“Why is this happening to me…?”
Apparently, if I slept, my body would break before my mind.
“What is that thing?”
Someone who appeared in my dreams. Someone who knew me and shared my senses. A murderer who roamed the streets killing people night after night.
What? You still refuse to admit it?
“…Admit what?”
I am you.
“…That’s impossible.”
You are the same as me.
“…No. I’m still sane.”
You went mad a long time ago.
“…I said that isn’t true…!”

「――やめてくれ。
そんな、いちいち同情しているような顔をされると気が滅入る」
「―――はい。
申し訳ありません、志貴さま」
「……やることがあるなら早く済ませてくれ。
どうせ俺には何もできないんだから、シーツを替えるなり点滴を換えるなり簡単にできるだろ」
「……はい、かしこまりました」
　翡翠は無言で点滴の中身を取りかえる。
　汗と血で汚れたシーツと寝巻を替えるのは琥珀さんの役割らしい。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
It irritated me. How could this woman not understand that her shallow concern only made me feel worse?
“Stop that. Having you make that pitying face at every little thing is depressing.”
“Yes. I’m sorry, Master Shiki.”
“…If you have something to do, then hurry and do it. I can’t do anything myself, so changing the sheets or replacing the IV should be easy enough.”
“…Yes. At once.”
Hisui silently changed the contents of the IV. Apparently, replacing the sheets and nightclothes soiled with sweat and blood was Kohaku’s duty.

「……いいけど、なに？」
「……はい。
志貴さまのお体は、その……痛むの、ですか」

Her work was finished, but Hisui made no move to leave the bedside.
“Hisui…?”
“Master Shiki… may I ask you one question?”
“?”
There was a faint tremor in her voice.
“…All right. What?”
“Does your body… hurt?”
“Wh—”
For one instant, I nearly screamed at her.

“Master Shiki, please do not strain yourself.”
That tone. That empty voice.
“…Shut up. It’s my body. I can do whatever I want with it!”

“Of course. To you, this is only happening to someone else. Why should it hurt you?”
“Master Shiki, please calm yourself.”
Her face remained still. Whatever abuse I hurled at her, she bore it in silence.
That only made me angrier.

That is what I keep telling you. We are the same.
“Again—”
You and I are the same person.
“Shut… up.”
Yes, the same. Just as I was locked away all this time, you too—
“Be quiet!”
You will spend your whole life trapped in that room.

You will never escape that cage. Not for the rest of your life.

“….”
Now I would dream of that basement again.

With those words, Hisui entered the room.
She closed the door but did not move a single step beyond it. In her hands were a silver tray and a glass of water.

lines.japanese:
「お飲み物をお持ちいたしましたが、お飲みになられますか？」
「――――――――」
　翡翠は本当に無表情だ。
　ただ、その指先が震えている。
「……翡翠」
　……どうして。
あんなコトまで言われたのに、彼女は俺なんかの看護をしてくれるんだろう。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“I brought you a drink. Would you like it?”
“—”
Her face truly was expressionless. But her fingertips were trembling.
“…Hisui.”
Why? After everything I had said, why would she still care for someone like me?

lines.japanese:
「……いいんだ翡翠。
無理をしなくていいから、俺なんかの相手をしなくて、いい」
「志貴さま。
わたしは無理なんてしていません。
志貴さまこそ、どうぞご無理はなさらないでください」
　感情のない翡翠の声。
　今も震えている白い指先。
　……ようやく気がついた。
　翡翠の声は、感情がないんじゃなくて、感情を押し殺した声なんだと。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“…It’s all right, Hisui. You don’t have to force yourself. You don’t have to look after someone like me.”
“I’m not forcing myself, Master Shiki. You are the one who must stop pushing himself.”
Her voice was empty. Her white fingertips still trembled. At last I understood: Hisui’s voice was not devoid of emotion. It was the voice she used to suppress it.
lines.mao_english:
“…It’s all right, Hisui. You don’t have to force yourself. You don’t have to look after someone like me.”
“I’m not forcing myself, Master Shiki. You are the one who must stop pushing himself.”
Her voice was empty. Her white fingertips still trembled. At last I understood: Hisui’s voice was not devoid of emotion. It was the voice she used to suppress it.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… It's okay, Hisui.
You don't have to force yourself; if you don't wish to be near me, it's fine."
"Shiki-sama, I am not forcing myself.
Rather, please do not force yourself, Shiki-sama."
Hisui's emotionless voice.
Her shaking fingers.
…… I finally realize it.
It isn't that her voice is emotionless; it's that she's killing the emotion in her voice.

lines.japanese:
「……ごめん。
俺のこと、軽蔑していい」
「いいんです、志貴さま。
わたしこそ何もできないのですから、責められて当然なんです」
――――そんな事、当然のハズがない。
　悪いのは、一方的にこっちなんだから。
「……すまない。
悪いけど、体が重いんだ。
自分じゃ飲めそうにないから、飲むのを手伝ってもらえないか」
「……はい。
そのお言葉を、お待ちしておりました」
　そうして、翡翠はベッドまで歩いてくる。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“…I’m sorry. You have every right to despise me.”
“It’s all right, Master Shiki. I can do nothing to help you, so I deserve your reproach.”
Of course she didn’t deserve that. I was the only one at fault.
“…I’m sorry, but my body feels heavy. I don’t think I can drink by myself. Would you help me?”
“…Yes. I have been waiting for you to ask.”
Hisui crossed the room to the bed.

「……失礼します」
　遠慮がちな声でそう言って、翡翠は俺の体を起こしてくれた。
「え―――翡翠？」
「どうぞ、ゆっくりお飲みください」
　片手で俺の背中を支えて、グラスを口に運んでくれる。
　今まで。
翡翠は決して、こっちの体には触れてこなかったのに。

“…Excuse me.”
Her voice hesitant, Hisui lifted my body upright.
“Huh—Hisui?”
“Drink slowly, please.”
She supported my back with one hand and brought the glass to my lips.
Until now, Hisui had never touched my body.

lines.japanese:
「…………」
　こくん、と水を数口含んで、首を横にふった。
　グラスを置く翡翠。
　そのまま、手の平を俺の額に重ねてくる。
――――どくん、と。
　今までとは違ったふうに、心臓が高鳴った。
「翡翠―――いい、のか」
　翡翠の手の平が離れる。
「……熱は、ないようです」
　うつむく翡翠。
　思ってもみなかった。
こんな事だけで、こんなにも俺は痛みが和らいでしまっている―――
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“….”
I swallowed several mouthfuls, then shook my head. Hisui set down the glass. Without withdrawing, she laid her palm against my forehead.
My heart thudded—but differently from before.
“Hisui… are you sure?”
Her palm left my skin.
“…You don’t seem to have a fever.”
Hisui lowered her eyes. I would never have believed that so small a touch could ease the pain so much.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…………"
Gulping down a few mouthfuls, I shake my head.
Hisui puts the glass to the side.
Then she puts her hand on my forehead.
----Thump.
My heart starts to pound heavily in a totally different way than other times.
"Hisui---is this, alright?"
Hisui lifts her hand.
"…… There does not, seem to be a fever."
Hisui murmurs this.
I didn't even think so.
All of my pain seems to fade away with just that---

“Would you… keep your hand there a little longer?”
“Why…?”
“…Your hand is cool. It feels good. When you touch me like that, I feel better.”
It was true. The agony of moments ago receded as though it had never existed.

lines.japanese:
翡翠はかすかに頬を赤らめて、はい、と消え入るように答えて、俺の額に手の平を重ねてきた。
「……不思議だ……なんか、なつかしい……」
　気分が落ち着く。
　意識が和らいでいく。
　……ああ、そういえば翡翠に看てもらったまま眠った時も、こんな感じだった。
「……ありがとう……ごめんな、翡翠」
　意識が沈む。
　ほんの僅かな時間。
　何日かぶりに、何の苦痛に悩まされることもない平穏な眠りにつく事ができた。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
Hisui’s cheeks colored faintly. “Yes,” she whispered, almost inaudibly, and laid her palm over my forehead once more.
“…Strange. It feels… familiar.”
Calm settled over me. My mind softened. Come to think of it, this was how I had felt when I fell asleep with Hisui watching over me before.
“…Thank you. And I’m sorry, Hisui.”
My awareness sank. It lasted only a little while, but for the first time in days I slipped into a peaceful sleep untouched by any kind of pain.

lines.mirrorMoon:
Hisui's cheeks turn slightly red, and with a smile, she places her hand on my forehead.
"…… That's strange…… Why do I feel nostalgic, all of a sudden……"
I feel relaxed.
My consciousness starts to become at ease.
…… Yeah, come to think of it, I felt like this when Hisui took care of me like this before.
"…… Thank you…… and sorry, Hisui."
My consciousness sinks into oblivion.
For a brief period of time.
For the first time in days, I slip into a peaceful sleep without any pain or suffering.

深夜になって、翡翠には部屋に戻ってもらった。
　さっきは気分が落ち着いてくれたが、いつまたあの『頭痛』がやってきて、俺が正気をなくしてしまうか分からない。
「っ…………」
　くわえて、俺の体はどうかしてる。
　指先一本だって動かないくせに、翡翠や琥珀さんの体を自由にするためだったら、それこそ俺の意思とは無関係に暴れ出してもおかしくない。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
Deep in the night, I sent Hisui back to her room. Her touch had calmed me before, but I had no idea when the “headache” might return and strip away my sanity.
“Ngh….”
And something was badly wrong with my body. It could not move so much as a fingertip for me, yet if it meant taking possession of Hisui’s or Kohaku’s body, it might run wild without the slightest regard for my will.

The headache would not stop. My body would not move. Perhaps pain was not the only thing that passed into me when that thing mutilated itself.
“Ngh—hah… ah… hah…!”
I broke into a fit of coughing. Ever since that thing began stabbing itself in the throat that afternoon, I had been unable to breathe properly.

「はぁ……はあ……は……ぐ」
　ぜー、ぜー。
　しわがれた声が夜に響いていく。
　故障したロボットじゃあるまいし、俺は息を吸う、なんて簡単なことさえ、細心の注意を払っていないと失敗してしまう。
「……ここまで……なのか、な」
　本来なら八年前に停止していた体だ。
　そりゃあ、いつかこうなる事ぐらい、考えてなかったワケじゃない。
lines.label: s402
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hah… hah… ha… gh….”
Wheeze, wheeze.
The rasp of my voice carried into the night. I was no broken robot, yet even the simple act of drawing breath failed unless I devoted my full attention to it.
“…Is this… the end?”
This body should have stopped eight years ago. I could hardly claim I had never imagined that someday it might come to this.
